title: Course theme
rule: Inside a customer's course, every `<aha-*>` component takes its colours, fonts and radius from the course theme: call `applyCourseTheme(root, theme)` from `@ahaslides-product/design/course-theme` on the element that wraps the lesson, and every DS component inside it re-skins. Never restyle a DS component by hand to match a course, and never read a course colour straight into a component.
why: A course theme is customer content (colour rule 9.1), so it is not held to the AhaSlides palette, but the DS components inside it still owe a readable result. `courseThemeVars` resolves the theme into the full `--aha-*` set, with every colour a component paints floored on every state: text and links 4.5:1, fills, focus rings and active borders 3:1, and every solid control's label 4.5:1 at rest, hover and press. The default theme (white surface, #1A1A1A text, Vivid Pink) reproduces the DS values exactly.
shared: Reuses the deck theme primitive: the same `parseColour` and `writeDeckVars` helpers `applyDeck` uses for the audience phone. `applyDeck` itself does not fit a course: it themes only ink and accent for frosted deck controls, while a course needs the product surfaces, neutrals, borders, focus and fonts every product component reads.

sections.name: Course theme in use
sections.what: The same lesson card under three course themes: light with a green brand, dark with a violet brand, and a bright amber brand on white. Every control is the shipped DS component; the measured pairs under each card are read from the live values.
sections.useWhen: learner pages, course players and any surface that renders inside a theme the customer chose
sections.notFor: AhaSlides' own app screens (they use the DS theme as shipped), slide decks and the audience phone (they use the deck tokens and `applyDeck`).

sections.snippet:
<script type="module">
  import 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ahaslides-product/ahaslides-design@__REF__/lib/all.js';
  import { applyCourseTheme } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ahaslides-product/ahaslides-design@__REF__/lib/course-theming.js';
  applyCourseTheme(document.querySelector('.lesson'), {
    primary: '#0B6E4F', surface: '#FFFFFF', pageBg: '#F2F7F5',
    textBody: '#1B2B26', textHeading: '#0B3D2E', fontBody: 'system-ui, sans-serif', radius: 4,
  });
</script>

sections.name: Theme inputs
sections.element: courseThemeVars({ primary, pageBg, surface, textBody, textHeading, accent, fontBody, fontHeading, radius })
sections.what: The minimum a customer theme may set. Every input is optional: an unset colour falls back to the DS light theme (or its dark twin when the surface is dark), an unset font or radius keeps the DS value.
sections.useWhen: mapping a course or learner-page theme onto the DS
sections.notFor: spacing, type scale, borders widths and shadows: those stay DS values.

rules.label: primary
rules.value: the brand colour: primary fill and its hover and press, links, focus ring, hover, focus and active borders, the selected tint. Shifted the least needed to pass its floors

rules.label: surface
rules.value: cards, inputs, menus, default buttons; every neutral is mixed on it

rules.label: pageBg
rules.value: the page behind the cards (`--aha-bg-layout`); defaults to the text colour at the DS layout grey share

rules.label: textBody
rules.value: body text and the whole neutral ladder: each DS grey is this ink at the share the DS ink has in that grey over white, so dark themes invert cleanly

rules.label: textHeading
rules.value: `--aha-course-text-heading`, for the course's own headings; floored 4.5:1

rules.label: accent
rules.value: `--aha-course-accent`, for the course's own highlights; floored 3:1. DS components never read it

rules.label: fontBody · fontHeading
rules.value: a CSS font-family list for `--aha-font-product` / `--aha-font-secondary` and `--aha-font-display`

rules.label: radius
rules.value: the default radius in px; the DS ladder scales from it (8 gives 4 · 6 · 8 · 12 · 16), clamped 0 to 16, pill stays round

sections.name: Contrast floors
sections.what: What the layer guarantees whatever the trainer picks. A colour that fails is moved toward black or white, whichever reaches the floor in fewer steps; a colour that passes is used verbatim.
sections.useWhen: judging whether a course theme can break a component
sections.notFor: course content the trainer writes themselves (their images and own markup).

rules.label: Text
rules.value: `--aha-text-default` and `-secondary` 4.5:1 on the surface, the page and the hover tints

rules.label: Links
rules.value: 4.5:1 on the surface; link hover also on the accent tint (on a grey or tint, text is ink: colour rule 6)

rules.label: Solid controls
rules.value: primary, positive and danger fills 3:1 on the surface and the page at rest, hover and press; the label (DS ink or white, whichever passes with the smaller shift) 4.5:1 on each

rules.label: Focus and borders
rules.value: focus ring, hover, focus and active borders, active icon 3:1 on the surface, the page and the hover tint

rules.label: Tertiary, placeholder
rules.value: never below the ratio the DS default ships (3.45:1 and 2.85:1 on white)

rules.label: Disabled
rules.value: not floored: WCAG exempts disabled controls

sections.name: Mapping a learner page
sections.what: How the e-learning learner page contract (`--lp-*`, from `learner-page-sdk/src/tokens.ts`) feeds the layer. The DS does not read `--lp-*` itself: the app reads its own variables and passes the values in.
sections.useWhen: wiring aha-elearning's learner pages, or any product with its own theme variables
sections.notFor: reading a host's variables through the cascade: pass resolved values.

rules.label: --lp-color-primary
rules.value: `primary` → --aha-color-primary(-hover|-active), --aha-button-primary-*, --aha-btn-positive-*, --aha-text-link(-hover), --aha-focus-ring, --aha-border-hover|focus|active, --aha-icon-active, --aha-bg-accent

rules.label: --lp-color-page-bg
rules.value: `pageBg` → --aha-bg-layout

rules.label: --lp-color-surface
rules.value: `surface` → --aha-bg-base|container|elevated, --aha-button-default-bg, and the ground every neutral is mixed on

rules.label: --lp-color-text-body
rules.value: `textBody` → --aha-text-default and the whole neutral ladder: --aha-text-secondary|tertiary|placeholder|disabled, --aha-icon-*, --aha-border-*, --aha-bg-hover, --aha-gray-10…100

rules.label: --lp-color-text-heading
rules.value: `textHeading` → --aha-course-text-heading (course content only: DS components set their titles in --aha-text-default)

rules.label: --lp-color-accent
rules.value: `accent` → --aha-course-accent (course content only: a DS component has one brand colour)

rules.label: --lp-font-body
rules.value: `fontBody` → --aha-font-product, --aha-font-secondary (and --aha-font-display when no heading font)

rules.label: --lp-font-heading
rules.value: `fontHeading` → --aha-font-display

rules.label: --lp-radius
rules.value: `radius` → --aha-radius-xs|sm|default|lg|xl, scaled from the DS ladder (8 = DS), clamped 0 to 16; pill stays

rules.label: --lp-font-scale, --lp-space-*, --lp-width-*, --lp-border-width, --lp-shadow
rules.value: not themed: the DS type scale, spacing, hairline and elevation stay fixed so components keep their measured layout

sections.name: Not themed
sections.what: What a course theme does not change, and why.
sections.useWhen: checking what a theme can reach

rules.label: Correct and wrong
rules.value: `--aha-answer-*` keep the DS green and red: their meaning cannot change per course (colour rule 11)

rules.label: Dark layers
rules.value: `--aha-bg-dark`, `-dark-raised`, `--aha-text-inverse`, `--aha-icon-inverse`, `--aha-bg-overlay`: tooltips and overlays stay dark on any theme

rules.label: Charts
rules.value: `--aha-viz-series-*` keep the DS series; the chart ink, neutral and tints follow the theme

rules.label: Layout
rules.value: spacing, type scale, border widths and shadows stay DS values
